tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Search the EscortFox directory of independent escorts, agencies and venues in one place. Returns up to 20 listing summaries per page: name, location, age, starting rate, verification status, incall/outcall, venue type, a short teaser and the listing's escortfox.com link. Summaries have no contact details or photos: always give the user each listing's link, where both are shown. "escort" and "venue" searches need country + city (find them with list_countries and list_cities); "agency" searches need country only. Only pages 0-4 (100 results) exist — narrow the search with district, service or verified instead of paging further.

type.description: What to look for: "escort" (individual escorts in a city), "venue" (clubs, studios and other places in a city) or "agency" (agencies serving a country).

country.description: Where to search: the country's `code` from list_countries (e.g. "DE"), or, in a country the site splits by state, the city's `region` from list_cities (e.g. "US-CA" for California). Agency searches cover this whole country or region.

city.description: The city to search in, as its `slug` from list_cities (e.g. "berlin"). Escort and venue searches are per city; agency searches are country-wide and take no city.

district.description: Narrows an escort or venue search to one part of the city: the district's `slug` from list_districts (e.g. "mitte"). Leave it out to search the whole city.

service.description: Narrows an escort search to escorts who offer one service: its `slug` from list_services (e.g. "massage").

verified.description: true = only escorts whose photos and phone number EscortFox has verified. Use it when the user asks for verified or genuine profiles.

lang.description: The language the user reads: advertiser teasers come back in it where the advertiser wrote one, and the escortfox.com links open the site in it (e.g. "de" for German). English when left out.

cursor.description: Asks for the next 20 results of the same search: the `nextCursor` of the previous search_listings result, unchanged. Leave it out for the first page.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Get the summary of one EscortFox listing by its numeric id. Returns the same fields as one search_listings result — name, location, age, starting rate, verification status, incall/outcall, venue type, teaser — and the listing's escortfox.com link; contact details and photos are only on that page. Use it to refresh a listing the user already has, or to read a link they pasted.

id.description: Which listing: the `id` of a search_listings result, or the number at the end of an escortfox.com listing link (…/anna-12345 → 12345).

lang.description: The language the user reads: advertiser teasers come back in it where the advertiser wrote one, and the escortfox.com links open the site in it (e.g. "de" for German). English when left out.

tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: List the countries that have active EscortFox listings. Returns each country's code (e.g. "DE"), its English name and how many escort and venue listings it has, so you can tell whether the directory covers a place before searching. Use a code as `country` in list_cities and search_listings.

tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: List the cities of a country that have active listings, busiest first. Returns each city's slug, name, state or province, escort and venue counts and its escortfox.com link. Use the city slug as `city` in search_listings, and the city's region as `country` where it differs from the country code (US states, e.g. "US-CA").

country.description: The country whose cities to list: its `code` from list_countries (e.g. "DE"), or a region code such as "US-CA" for one state only.

tools.name: list_districts
tools.description: List the districts of one city that have active listings. Returns each district's slug, name and escort and venue counts. Most cities have none: an empty list means search the whole city. Use a district slug as `district` in search_listings.

country.description: The city's `region` from list_cities: its country code, or its state code in a country the site splits by state (e.g. "US-CA").

city.description: The city whose districts to list: its `slug` from list_cities (e.g. "berlin").

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List the services escorts can offer on EscortFox. Returns each service's slug and English name (e.g. "massage" = Massage). Use a slug as `service` in search_listings to find escorts who offer it; services apply to escort searches only.
